tpms.when: 2016 Countryman, set from the button on the end of the turn signal lever
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Start the engine but stay parked.
Tap the button on the end of the turn signal lever repeatedly until SET/INFO shows in the display.
Press and hold the button until the display changes.
Tap the button repeatedly until the tire symbol shows with RESET.
Press and hold the button until the display changes. Cars with tire pressure sensors show RESETTING.
Drive off. After a short drive above about 20 mph the new pressures are saved; cars without wheel sensors finish while driving with no message.
tpms.note: Do not reset with snow chains on or with a space-saver spare. On cars with wheel sensors, a tire light that flashes and then stays on means the system cannot detect pressure loss and needs checking.

tpms.when: 2024 Countryman with the My MINI menu on the center screen
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Start the engine but do not drive off.
On the center screen, open My MINI, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Select Perform reset. The wheels show gray while it resets.
Drive off. The reset finishes on its own after several minutes of driving, and it resumes if you stop partway.

notes: The MINI owner's manuals we opened show the service reminders but give no driver reset for the oil service reminder; a service advisor reads the service data from the key. Only the tire pressure reset is listed here.
